$comment: ⚖ USER RULING 2026-11-11: "Add the directional gates for now, but make a note to reexamine this later." A PER-ROOM TABLE, licensed for now in place of a general derivation; read by seedlingNoHitDirectionalGates.js (whose header carries the ruling and the direction to re-examine). Each gate names a wallflyer band by its flyers (the tiles come from seedlingWallFlyerBands.wallFlyerBands, never typed here), the compass direction of movement that costs an arm (y grows down, so N is south to north), the witnessed arm set as engine flags, and its witnesses in scripts/procgen/seedling-wallflyer-nohit-plans.json: `notFound` (the no-item searches of the blocked direction that ended without a plan), `arms` (one game-verified no-hit plan per arm, blocked direction) and `free` (game-verified no-item plans of the reverse direction). A witness id missing from the plans file refuses the gate by name.
reexamine: TO BE RE-EXAMINED (the user, 2026-11-11). The general rule slice rules-no-hit-l22 suggested, not built: a band is passable with no item where the room offers a waiting spot off the ray at the far end of every flight. NOT FOUND is a search budget, never "impossible". The Wand is unwitnessed and Fire was not found; neither is an arm here.

west to east: from the L26 door to the L22/L28 doors, across the two flyer columns
